answer.answer: AAPL's reported revenue history in ST-EVA spans 339 observations from fiscal 2007 (period ending 2007-09-29) through the quarter ended 2026-06-27. The series is not truncated and contains both quarterly and annual data points, with multiple filings (10-K, 10-K/A, 10-Q, 8-K) for many periods reflecting restatements and different acceptance dates. Revenue grew from $24.0 billion in FY2007 to $416.2 billion in FY2025 (latest annual filing). The reporting framework changes over time: early points use us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet (mapping_fidelity PARTIAL), while later points use us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax (mapping_fidelity EXACT). A single vendor-sourced point (YahooFinance) for the trailing twelve months ended 2024-06-30 is also present. Because points declare different reporting frameworks (us-gaap and vendor), the series is not considered a single comparable series and has not been merged. All observations are SOURCE_REPORTED and UNVERIFIABLE (no cross-check validation).
uncertainties: The series mixes quarterly and annual periods without a single consistent periodicity.
